groups.title: 1. System, users and platform
groups.intro: System settings and upgrades, authentication, users and roles, certificates, backup and restore, tasks, files and ITSM (API families: System Settings, Users, Backup, Task, ITSM and similar).

groups.title: 2. Site hierarchy and design
groups.intro: Areas, buildings, floors and site design (API families: Sites, Site Design).

groups.title: 3. Network settings, IPAM and tags
groups.intro: Global and site network settings, credentials, IP pools and tags (API families: Network Settings, Tag).

groups.title: 4. Discovery, inventory and PnP
groups.intro: Discovery, device inventory, Plug and Play onboarding, device replacement and licences (API families: Discovery, Devices, Device Onboarding (PnP), Device Replacement, Licenses).

groups.title: 5. Software image management (SWIM)
groups.intro: Import, tag, distribute and activate images (API family: Software Image Management (SWIM)).

groups.title: 6. Templates, LAN automation and compliance
groups.intro: Configuration templates, archive, command runner, LAN automation and compliance (API families: Configuration Templates, Configuration Archive, Command Runner, LAN Automation, Compliance).

groups.title: 7. SD-Access fabric
groups.intro: Fabric sites, zones, transits, virtual networks, border/edge devices and fabric wireless (API families: SDA, Fabric Wireless).

groups.title: 8. Wired and industrial
groups.intro: Wired campus automation and industrial configuration (API families: Wired, Industrial Configuration).

groups.title: 9. Wireless
groups.intro: Wireless profiles, SSIDs, RF profiles, access points and controllers (API family: Wireless).

groups.title: 10. Application policy and endpoint analytics
groups.intro: Applications, application policy and AI Endpoint Analytics (API families: Application Policy, Applications, AI Endpoint Analytics).

groups.title: 11. Assurance, events and reports
groups.intro: Clients, issues, health, sensors, path trace, events, reports, security advisories, EoX and topology.
